details: Spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded a net outflow of $1.28 billion in the week ending November 6, marking the worst weekly performance since June and pushing year-to-date flows into negative territory. BlackRock's IBIT alone saw $403 million in outflows on Friday. This significant withdrawal is attributed to a combination of US midterm election results and ongoing uncertainties surrounding AI spending.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See $1.28 Billion Outflow, Turn Negative for 2026

details: The US Treasury's Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) has issued an order preventing American financial institutions from processing transactions involving the crypto exchange MEXC Global. This action follows allegations that MEXC facilitated approximately $16.7 billion in illicit transactions, including those linked to Russian sanctions evasion, numerous Iranian crypto exchanges, and North Korean money laundering.
title: US Treasury Cuts Off MEXC Global Over $16B Illicit Transactions

details: Major Bitcoin mining company Core Scientific has announced its plan to completely cease Bitcoin mining operations by the end of 2026. The company will instead pivot its business strategy to focus on artificial intelligence (AI) and high-performance computing infrastructure. Bitcoin mining revenue accounted for only 7.5% of its third-quarter revenue, highlighting the strategic shift.
title: Core Scientific to Exit Bitcoin Mining by Year-End, Focus on AI

details: World Liberty Financial, a cryptocurrency venture backed by Donald Trump, is initiating a buyback program for its WLFI governance token. This decision comes after the token experienced a approximately 10% drop following the Republican Party's weaker-than-expected performance in the recent US midterm elections, with its value down over 60% year-to-date.
title: Trump-Backed WLFI Token Launches Buyback After Midterm Losses

details: The Injective (INJ) cryptocurrency saw a notable price increase, surging 10% after the launch and approval of the Canary Staked INJ ETF (ticker INJC) on Nasdaq. This new exchange-traded fund is designed to offer staked exposure to INJ, providing staking rewards to investors and generating significant speculative and institutional interest in the asset.
title: Injective (INJ) Surges 10% Following Nasdaq ETF Launch

details: As of November 8, Bitcoin's price has stabilized around $75,950 after a recent decline, showing a slight 0.09% increase over 24 hours. Funding rates for both Bitcoin (BTC) and Ethereum (ETH) are currently in the neutral range, indicating an easing of previously bearish sentiment for Ethereum.
title: Bitcoin Steadies Near $75,950; ETH Bearish Sentiment Eases

details: Nu Holdings Ltd. (Nubank), a prominent Brazilian digital bank, has temporarily suspended cryptocurrency deposits and withdrawals. The company cited a problem with an external provider as the reason for the halt. This development occurs shortly after a significant hack on Binance, raising concerns about operational security in the crypto sector.
title: Nubank Halts Crypto Transactions Citing Provider Issues
